question: Do they compare human-level performance to model performance for their dataset?
title: Adversarial NLI: A New Benchmark for Natural Language Understanding
answer_rationale: The dataset was collected via an iterative, adversarial human-and-model-in-the-loop procedure, explicitly involving non-expert annotators identifying model weaknesses, which implies direct comparison of human and model performance during development. Text 3 confirms that non-expert annotators are successful at finding model weaknesses, and Text 4 describes the human-and-model-in-the-loop training as a method for comparing and improving performance.
